card.name: Partway through numbers and times
card.fires_on: Digits inside a number (such as the 9 in Tc 99m, 1 in 10 6, 0 in 25,000, 2 in 2019), the a or p in a.m./p.m. times, and the end of the word Nonselective before beta-blockers.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A single digit in the middle of a multi-digit number, isotope name, or year.

modes.label: a.m./p.m. times
modes.description: The a or p letter after a clock time, just before the period and m.

modes.label: Nonselective
modes.description: The ending of Nonselective in a drug class name before Beta-Adrenergic Antagonists.

card.writes: It pushes down the next piece being a continuing number or word piece, favoring single letters like h, g, t, p.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of numbers, clock times, and one long drug-class word, where the text is not finished yet.
